argument:
CelcomDigi's RM141m year-to-date operating savings and 47.2% Home & Fibre revenue growth offer identifiable improvement levers within a recurring-service business. Service revenue increased 1.4% in Q2 and 1.5% in H1, keeping the base stable enough for integration savings to potentially improve earnings. A bullish scenario is that savings and fibre expansion progressively outweigh financing and prepaid pressure.

That improvement has not yet reached quarterly PAT, which fell 7.7%; prepaid revenue declined 3.2% and finance costs increased. Debt maturities are unknown. Oversold RSI around 27 permits a recovery but does not establish one when price and MACD remain weak. The case warrants monitoring operating-cost delivery and funding costs rather than treating the low-price location as a buy signal.
key_points: Reported savings and fibre growth are concrete improvement channels.
PAT and prepaid deterioration show the turnaround is incomplete.
Oversold price action provides optionality, not confirmation.
